Carbonic Anhydrase Inhibitors

Pharmacokinetics

Mechanism of Action

Therapeutic Uses

Pharmacokinetics

Mechanism of Action 1

Diuretic

Mechanism of Action 2

Decrease aqueous humor production

Mechanism of Action 3

Decrease CSF secretion

Therapeutic Uses

Not used as diuretic anymore due to metabolic acidosis and kidney compensating very quickly

Therapeutic Uses 1

Glaucoma

Therapeutic Uses 2

Acute mountain sickness (respiratory alkalosis)

Therapeutic Uses 3

Metabolic alkalosis

Adverse Effects 1

Metabolic acidosis

Adverse Effects 2

Renal stones

Adverse Effects 3

Potassium Depletion

Adverse Effects 4

Hypersensitivity reactions
